PageNote.title: PageNote
PageNote.description: An anonymous or owner-authored sticky note attached to a page on Hộp giấy của Etar.

pageKey.description: Normalized identifier of the page this note belongs to.

pageTitle.description: Human-readable title of the page for display in the all-pages feed.

pagePath.description: Internal relative URL path of the page starting with '/'.

nickname.description: Optional reader nickname, defaults to 'Khách ghé thăm'.

emojiId.description: Optional custom image emoji ID stamped on the note, or empty string.

paperTone.description: Celestial paper tint theme for the sticky note.

pinned.description: Whether the site owner pinned this note to the top.

isOwner.description: True only when posted by the authenticated site owner.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the note was posted.

PageReaction.title: PageReaction
PageReaction.description: Aggregated counter for a single custom image emoji on a specific page.

count.description: Non-negative total reaction count for this emoji on this page.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest reaction update.

/page_notes/{noteId}.description: Public sticky notes left by visitors and the site owner across public pages.

/page_reactions/{reactionId}.description: Per-page custom image emoji reaction counters keyed by '{pageKey}__{emojiId}'.
